plan.subject: Marketing science

queries.query: ("charm pricing" OR "price ending" OR "left-digit effect" OR ".99 pricing" OR "just-below pricing") AND (marketing OR consumer OR retail OR ecommerce OR pricing)
queries.rationale: Catches evidence on whether .99 and related price-ending tactics still shift demand, perception, or conversion in commerce settings.

queries.query: ("price discount" OR "sales promotion" OR coupon OR cashback) AND (marketing OR consumer OR retail OR ecommerce OR "purchase intention")
queries.rationale: Surfaces broad empirical work on discount mechanics, promotional incentives, and short-run conversion effects relevant to campaign planning.

queries.query: ("promotion depth" OR "discount depth" OR "percentage-off framing" OR "dollar-off framing") AND (marketing OR consumer OR retail OR ecommerce)
queries.rationale: Targets findings on how the size and presentation of a discount change response beyond simply offering a promotion.

queries.query: ("price promotion" OR coupon OR discount) AND ("brand equity" OR "brand dilution" OR "brand image" OR "reference price")
queries.rationale: Finds studies on the downside of repeated promotions, including brand erosion, lower willingness to pay, and reference-price effects.

queries.query: ("scarcity appeal" OR "scarcity cue" OR "limited-time offer" OR "limited quantity" OR urgency) AND (marketing OR consumer OR retail OR ecommerce OR checkout)
queries.rationale: Covers whether stock scarcity, time pressure, and urgency messaging increase conversion and under what boundary conditions.

queries.query: ("social proof" OR "customer reviews" OR ratings OR testimonials) AND (marketing OR consumer OR ecommerce OR conversion OR checkout)
queries.rationale: Captures research on reviews, ratings, and testimonial signals that influence trust, checkout behavior, and purchase likelihood.

queries.query: ("message framing" OR "gain frame" OR "loss frame" OR "benefit framing") AND (marketing OR advertising OR consumer OR conversion)
queries.rationale: Targets studies comparing gain-vs-loss and related framing choices in persuasive messages and their effects on response.

queries.query: ("advertising creativity" OR "ad creativity" OR "creative effectiveness" OR "advertising appeal") AND (advertising OR marketing OR consumer OR conversion)
queries.rationale: Finds evidence on which creative features make ads more persuasive or memorable rather than just aesthetically novel.

queries.query: ("emotional appeal" OR "rational appeal" OR humor OR storytelling) AND (advertising OR marketing OR consumer OR persuasion)
queries.rationale: Surfaces comparisons of emotional, rational, humorous, and narrative ad approaches that matter for conversion-oriented creative decisions.

queries.query: ("product naming" OR "brand name" OR "brand naming" OR "product name fluency") AND (marketing OR branding OR consumer OR ecommerce)
queries.rationale: Targets research on how names affect recall, perceived quality, fit, and purchase behavior for products and brands.

queries.query: ("processing fluency" OR "name fluency" OR pronounceability OR readability) AND (marketing OR branding OR consumer OR choice)
queries.angle: fluency effects in names and copy
queries.rationale: Catches work on whether easy-to-process names and wording improve trust, preference, and decision speed.

queries.query: ("choice architecture" OR nudge OR nudging OR defaults) AND (marketing OR consumer OR ecommerce OR conversion)
queries.rationale: Finds studies on lightweight behavioral interventions such as defaults and nudges that can move purchase or signup behavior.

queries.query: ("decoy effect" OR "attraction effect" OR "compromise effect") AND (marketing OR consumer OR pricing OR choice)
queries.rationale: Targets research on how adding or structuring options changes selection, upsell rates, and perceived value.

queries.query: ("anchoring effect" OR "price anchor" OR "reference price" OR "strike-through price") AND (marketing OR consumer OR retail OR ecommerce)
queries.rationale: Surfaces evidence on list prices, struck-through prices, and anchors that alter value perception and conversion.

queries.query: (personalization OR customization OR targeting) AND ("digital advertising" OR "online advertising" OR ecommerce OR conversion)
queries.rationale: Covers whether personalized messages, offers, or targeting improve performance and when personalization backfires.

queries.query: ("landing page" OR "product page" OR "checkout page" OR "conversion rate optimization") AND (ecommerce OR retail OR marketing OR conversion)
queries.rationale: Captures research on page-level interventions and interface choices tied directly to conversion outcomes in online commerce.

queries.query: ("call to action" OR CTA OR "button text" OR "copy testing") AND (marketing OR ecommerce OR conversion OR persuasion)
queries.rationale: Finds experiments on microcopy and CTA wording that influence clicks, signups, and purchase decisions.

queries.query: ("A/B testing" OR experiment OR experimentation OR "field experiment") AND (marketing OR ecommerce OR advertising OR pricing)
queries.rationale: Acts as a recall-safety query for recent empirical marketing studies with stronger causal designs across the reader's core problem set.

plan.coverage_notes: This plan covers pricing, promotions, creative effectiveness, product naming, behavioral nudges, social proof, personalization, and conversion-page optimization with a bias toward experimentally testable tactics. I included a few broader recall-safety queries for recent empirical work, but skipped advertising history, media theory, and highly brand-strategy-heavy angles because the profile is performance-oriented and wants actionable evidence. The main assumption is that this reader values mechanisms that can be tested in e-commerce funnels more than broad communications theory.
